lines.text: Many learners say: I enjoy to swim.
Listening to! I enjoy listening to music.

native.tip: 中文“喜欢游泳”里，动词原样放在后面。英语的 enjoy 后面要用 ing 形式，不能加 to。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I enjoy to swim.”😅 enjoy 后面用 ing，不加 to：“I enjoy swimming.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I enjoy swimming.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese verbs stay the same after “like”, but in English enjoy needs ing, not to.
en.caption: Do you say “I enjoy to swim.” 😅 Enjoy needs ing, not to: “I enjoy swimming.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
